fixed_vs_float.rationale: Taps rounded to Q15 (sum of |tap rounding error| 1.3430981883075682e-4) acting on an input peak of 0.705 FS per component, plus 0.5 LSB of output rounding (Q15) and 0.02 Q15 LSB for the f32 reference itself; per component <= 3.622750221129599 Q15 LSB, x sqrt(2) for the complex magnitude. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: f32 rounding in an 25-tap sum: each of the n additions errs by at most 2^-24 of the partial sum (<= peak * sum|taps| = 1.0613051569394778); twice that covers both evaluation orders (GNU Radio uses SIMD kernels): 0.1466 Q15 LSB. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.
